face.name: 警戒哨卫
face.text: 嘲讽。战吼：如果你的牌库中没有中立卡牌，召唤两个警戒哨卫。
face.flavorText: 现在全达拉然都知道你来了。

face.name: Vigilant Sentry
face.text: Taunt Battlecry: If your deck has no Neutral cards, summon two Vigilant Sentries.
face.flavorText: Now all of Dalaran knows you're here.

face.name: 怨毒大厨
face.text: 战吼：召唤一个法力值消耗为（2）的嘲讽随从。如果你拥有至少10点法力值，改为召唤法力值消耗为（6）的嘲讽随从。
face.flavorText: 我只是说了句多加点盐而已！

face.name: Spiteful Chef
face.text: Battlecry: Summon a 2-Cost Taunt minion. If you have 10 or more Mana, summon a 6-Cost instead.
face.flavorText: All I said was that it needed a touch more salt!

face.name: 预言师
face.text: 预备。嘲讽。亡语：为你的英雄恢复 6点生命值。&随机召唤一个法力值消耗为（6）的随从。
face.flavorText: “精神放松。预言的……力度可以吗？”

face.name: Soothsayer
face.text: Prepare, Taunt Deathrattle: Restore 6 Health to your hero.& Summon a random 6-Cost minion.
face.flavorText: "Sooth. Sooth. ...Sooth. Am I doing it right?"

face.name: 野兽绊索
face.text: 随机召唤一只法力值消耗为（5）的野兽。将两张法术牌洗入你的牌库，抽到该法术时会再随机 召唤一次。
face.flavorText: 就在那一刻，她明白了，这是牵绊的感觉。

face.name: Beast Tripwire
face.text: Summon a random 5-Cost Beast. Shuffle 2 spells into your deck that do it again when drawn.
face.flavorText: And it was at that moment, she knew, she tripped up.

face.name: 钟表先生克劳沃斯
face.text: 回溯，回溯，回溯 战吼：随机召唤2个传说随从。
face.flavorText: “先生，请问您的钟表价值几何？”“时分珍贵啊，亲爱的孩子。”

face.name: Mister Clocksworth
face.text: Rewind, Rewind, Rewind Battlecry: Summon 2 random Legendary minions.
face.flavorText: "Hey Mister, what're your clocks worth?" "Depends on the hour, my boy."

face.name: 血色斗士
face.text: 亡语：如果你的牌库中没有中立卡牌，&随机获取一张圣骑士牌，其法力值消耗减少（2）点。
face.flavorText: 血色的重点在于血。

face.name: Scarlet Bruiser
face.text: Deathrattle: If your deck has no Neutral cards,& get a random Paladin card. It costs (2) less.
face.flavorText: She puts the "scar" in scarlet.

face.flavorText: 稍等，我这就把我的光环具象化。

face.name: Manifested Timeways
face.text: Battlecry: If you control an Aura,& deal 3 damage to all enemies.
face.flavorText: Hold on, I'm manifesting my Aura.

face.name: Starsurge
face.text: Deal damage to a minion. (Improved by each friendly minion that died this game.)
face.flavorText: "The stars urge you to DIE."

face.flavorText: Omg your card back is SO last season.

face.flavorText: “我看到了安布拉的亡灵大军。我……我就在上面好了。”

face.flavorText: "I got eyes on Umbra's unstoppable undead army. I'll uh... stay wayyy up here."
